REJECTED — false positive on the core claim. The metrics are real and reproduced, but the diagnosis ("la imagen hero del LCP no se precarga") misidentifies the LCP element and the remedy.

VERIFIED TRUE (from lighthouse.json + live curl HTTP 200, no captcha):
- LCP=2861.93ms, score 0.81, Perf 0.94, mobile, LH 13.4.0, fetchTime 2026-06-29T20:02Z — exact match.

- Hero structure (full-bleed img z-index:0, dark overlay z-index:1, cream/white .hero text z-index:2) is accurate; the "white text not legible until backdrop paints" mechanism is plausible.

FALSE / MISREPRESENTED (load-bearing errors):
1. The LCP element is NOT the hero image. lcp-breakdown-insight identifies it as `main#top > section.hero > div.hero-content > h1.hero-title` — a TEXT node. The finding's title/scope claim the LCP element is `img.hero-img`.
2. The preload remedy is contradicted by Lighthouse. `lcp-discovery-insight` (the audit that literally recommends "making the LCP image discoverable from the HTML immediately") is scoreDisplayMode:"notApplicable", score null — Lighthouse does NOT flag the hero for preload. The hero image already loads at priority "High" via fetchpriority and sits in static HTML inside <picture> near top of <body>; a preload would not move LCP since the LCP is text.
3. The `image-delivery-insight` metricSavings.LCP=150ms is misrepresented. Its subitems read "Increasing the image compression factor could improve this image's download size" (est. 33 KiB) — a COMPRESSION recommendation, not a preload/discovery confirmation as the finding states.
4. Internal inconsistency: headline LCP 2.9s pairs with scored FCP=1.0s (score 1.0), which do NOT coincide. The "FCP y LCP coinciden en 2354 ms" claim cherry-picks observedFirstContentfulPaint/observedLargestContentfulPaint=2354 (a different, unthrottled-projection metric set) and contradicts the same finding's own scored numbers.

NET: The symptom (LCP 2.9s, "needs improvement") is genuine and reproducible, so it is not nothing — but the stated root cause (un-preloaded hero IMAGE as LCP element) is wrong; the actual lever is the 2166ms element render delay on the H1 text rendered atop the full-bleed hero, and the only image win Lighthouse offers is ~150ms from compression (already loading High priority). Recommending hero-image preload would be a no-op. Severity lowered to low because the headline action item is misdirected.
